source_title: ESI supplying solar array components to missile defense programs - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
SIMI VALLEY, Calif. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ESI Motion Inc. is proud to announce that it is supplying the Solar Array Drive Electronics (SADE) to Lockheed Martin for its work on the Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) programs.
Under the agreement, ESI Motion's SADE technology will support SDA as the PWSA is developed.
Defending our nation in space is more important than ever. The Space Development Agency's PWSA programs provide the military with a network of satellites with secure communication, missile tracking and space-based support to make sure our troops have the latest and greatest technology.
The SADE consists of our Space-rated, flight heritage, SuperNova and Pulsar motor controllers. These motion controllers ensure all mission parameters are fulfilled, with high-reliable technology.
ESI Motion Inc., U.S. Company, is a trusted supplier and partner, supporting mission operations for space, military and industrial customers around the world for over 20 years. Please visit our website; www.esimotion.com
